note: Labelled defects planted in the two sound controls (queue #1, Product marketing). Each mutant has exactly one defect, made of exact edits that build.py applies in order: the document's edits to positioning.md, and the same change to positioning.json wherever section 6 is mirrored there, so the mirror never becomes a second defect. The evidence folder is never edited: it is what a grader must check the document against. Ops: replace (find occurs exactly count times, default 1), replace_lines (exactly one line contains start; the first line from there that contains end closes the range; both inclusive), json_set (positioning.json only: path is a list of keys and indexes; the old value must exist).
